t: A tiny, very cheap Arm chip from Texas Instruments for simple jobs.
steps: Buy the LP-MSPM0C1104 LaunchPad from the TI Store or DigiKey for about 6 to 8 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Install the free TI MSPM0 SDK and Code Composer Studio from the TI website.
Plug in the LaunchPad and let it find the built-in debug probe.
Open the SDK LED blink example for the MSPM0C1104.
Build and flash it to blink the red LED.
Try the Embassy Rust examples for this chip next.
meta: Open Board. From $7.49. A few stores.
